Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires are out in the middle along with the Pakistan players. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks are the openers for South Africa. Imad Wasim to start proceedings with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...
Right then! South Africa need 187 runs! A big task on their batters and someone has to raise their hands up and take the team over the line. Stay tuned for the second essay.

After opting to bowl first, South Africa had a great start as they got both the openers cheaply. They failed to keep the game in control in the middle phase and that saw Pakistan taking advantage. They failed to make an impact and the bowlers went for a few runs especially Anrich Nortje and Bjorn Fortuin. Kagiso Rabada struck twice in the fag end of the innings but it was too late as the damage was already done. Other than that, the big concern for South Africa will be the injury of Tabraiz Shamsi as he walked back during the match.

Not the start Pakistan have wished for but this is a remarkable innings from them. Their openers gave a brisk start but lost their way quickly. Zaman and Hafeez tried to steady the ship but the latter fell in trying to and then Malik joined hands in the middle to put Pakistan in pole position. Zaman was the aggressor as he was dealing in sixes while Malik rotated the strike nicely. Later, Zaman brought up his fifty in just 28 balls and made way for Asif Ali. Both took some time before relishing themselves and hammering the opposition all over the parks. Asif Ali scored a quickfire 32 before giving away his wicket. A brilliant batting performance from Pakistan and they will fancy their chances.
A full toss, on off stump. Khan heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single. PAKISTAN END WITH 186/6!
Fullish ball, around off and slashed over extra cover for a couple of runs.
Full and straight, Ali digs it out onto the deck. They scamper through and Anrich Nortje has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
SIX! Bang! In the slot and Hasan Ali gets low to smoke it over the cow corner fence for a huge hit.
Another perfect wide yorker, Khan manages to squeeze it towards backward point for a run.
A wide yorker from Anrich Nortje. Ali gets it through covers for a single.
Full toss, outside off stump. Ali slashes it to deep point for a single.
Shadab Khan walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kagiso Rabada bangs one into the pitch and gets the big wicket of Shoaib Malik. This one is a bit too high and Malik has a poke at it as he looks to guide it over short third man. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat and pops up towards short third man. Anrich Nortje takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Anrich Nortje b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Full and straight, Ali inside-edges it towards backward square leg for a single.
Full and wide, squeezed to deep point for a run by Malik.
Full, on off and Hasan Ali hits straight to the cover region for a quick single.
Hasan Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Cleaned up! Full and straight, you miss and I hit stuff from Kagiso Rabada. Asif Ali walks right across the stumps as he tries to ramp it over short fine leg. Ali gets beaten for pace and the ball crashes into the leg stump. South Africa finally get the breakthrough.
Asif Ali is retiring himself out.
Fullish, on off and driven through covers for a couple of runs. 19 off the over!
Full and wide, stroked through covers for a single.
SIX! WOW! Asif Ali is hitting Anrich Nortje all over the place. A length ball, on off and Ali smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Short but not too short to trouble the batter. Ali rocks back and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a another boundary.
FOUR! In the slot and hammered over mid off for a boundary.
A length ball, around off. Ali throws his hands at it and gets a top edge which flies down towards third man. They race back for the second.
Anrich Nortje is back into the attack.
Dragged down, on middle. Asif Ali rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flighted ball, on middle. Malik skips down the track and pushes it to long on for one.
On middle and tucked away on the leg side for one.
FIVE WIDES! And again, what is happening out there! Fired in down the leg side and the ball races away into the fence.
FIVE WIDES! Spilled down the leg side and beats everyone. The ball races away into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
SIX! Wow! Tossed up, on off. Asif Ali hangs back and smokes it over the long off fence for a maximum.
Flatter one, on middle. Malik works it through deep mid-wicket for a run.
On off and stroked through point for a single.
Bjorn Fortuin is back on.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Length ball, on leg. Shoaib Malik clears his front leg and sends the ball sailing over long on for a maximum.
On the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Slower and short, on middle. Asif Ali looks to pull but misses. Wide called for height.
Rabada fires a yorker on leg, Shoaib Malik clips it to deep square leg for one.
Full and outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
A low full toss on middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on off. Asif Ali looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack.
Full again, on off. Malik drives it to long off and keeps the strike by taking a run.
Outside off, Shoaib Malik smashes it through covers but will only get a single.
Fuller in length, outside off. Asif Ali drives it straight to cover. He takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had that hit, Asif Ali was a goner.
Length ball, on middle. Asif Ali knocks it back to the bowler.
Full again, on middle. Asif Ali whips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full and on off, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Fakhar Zaman is retiring himself out after getting his half-century and is making way for Asif Ali who joins Shoaib Malik in the middle.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and on the pads, Fakhar Zaman flicks it towards deep square leg. Picks up another boundary. He gets to his fifty as well off just 28 balls.
Full and wide outside off, slashed to cover-point for a single.
On a length on off, worked to mid-wicket.
Short of a length, outside off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and slanting across the left-hander, outside off. Fakhar Zaman swings his bat but misses.
On a length, outside off. Malik dabs it to short third man. He crosses ends.
Lungi Ngidi is back on.
SIX! KABOOM! Fakhar Zaman is enjoying out there in the middle. Length ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman muscles it over long on for a biggie. That was his fifth maximum!
FOUR! Short ball, on middle. Fakhar Zaman pulls it with disdain to deep square leg for a boundary. 100 up for Pakistan.
Wiaan Mulder steams in but slips as he was going to deliver. Thankfully, gets up quickly and is ready to bowl again.
On a good length, around off. Malik nudges it long on for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Wiaan Mulder errs in his line and bowls it on the pads, Shoaib Malik tickles it to fine leg for a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off. Zaman steers it to deep point for a run.
Length ball, on off. Malik pushes it to long on for a single.
Wiaan Mulder is into the attack.
Flatter and on off. Malik skips down and mistimes his heave to deep mid-wicket. One.
Darted on the pads, flicked to square leg for one.
Very full and angling on the pads. Zaman jams it out to mid-wicket and collects a couple.
Flatter on middle. Malik pushes it to long on for one more.
On middle, eased down to long off for a single.
SIX! hitting maximums with ease! A tossed up ball, way outside off. Zaman throws the kitchen sink at it and connects really well. Hits it over long off for a biggie.
Flatter and way outside off. Zaman dabs it to backward point for a single.
SIX! Zaman continues to go big! A full ball, on middle. Zaman slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Another single as this is nudged to mid-wicket.
Angles it on middle. Malik flicks it with gentle hands to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fortuin tosses it up and Zaman eases it down to long off for a single.
On middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Change.
Flatter and outside off. Zaman slaps it to point where the fielder makes a great stop.

DRINKS! With that wicket, the umpires decide to take drinks. South Africa have done well to scalp wickets at regular intervals. Pakistan need someone to play longer innings now. Also, Shoaib Malik walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Captain, Bavuma leading from the front and South Africa get a breakthrough. A full ball, on off, lands and spins away a bit. Mohammad Hafeez comes down the track looking to go big but does not read the turn. The ball takes the outer half of the bat and lobs in the air towards cover where Temba Bavuma runs backward and takes an absolute stunner.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Tabraiz Shamsi has some issue with his hand and is walking off the field. Keshav Maharaj to complete his over.
Flighted ball, on off. Zaman pushes it down to long off for a single.
A flatter ball, outside off. Zaman misses his cut.
SIX! THUMPED! A full ball, on middle. Zaman dances down the track and smokes it over long on for a maximum.
Starts with a full ball, angling on the pads. Zaman looks to paddle it but misses and gets hit on the pads. Shamsi appeals for LBW but the umpire says no.
Tabraiz Shamsi to roll his arm now.
Full and way outside off. Zaman drives it to deep point for a single.
SIX! BANG! A full ball, on off. Zaman slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Another short ball, outside off. Zaman looks to cut but misses it completely.
Short and on off. Hafeez rocks back and cuts it to backward point for a quick single.
Full on middle. Blocked out on the leg side.
Loopy ball, on middle, hit back to the bowler.
Bjorn Fortuin comes into the attack.
A good short ball, over the shoulders of Fakhar Zaman. Zaman looks to hook but gets beaten by the pace. The bowler lets out a stifled appeal but the umpire isn't interested.
Back of a length and guided towards third man for another one.
Good-length ball, around off. Zaman cuts it through point for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Hafeez pushes it down to long on for a single.

SIX! Bang! Mohammad Hafeez decides to take on Anrich Nortje and gets maximum return. In the slot and Hafeez launches it high towards long on. David Miller settles under it and the ball just gets a bit too big on him as he palms it over the ropes.
A length ball, on top of off. Hafeez gets right behind the line of the ball to keep it out.
Around off and nudged behind point for a single.
LEG BYE! Ngidi looks for the inswinging yorker but ends up serving a low full toss on the pads. Fakhar Zaman misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads towards mid-wicket. They get a leg bye.
Back of a length, around off. Hafeez steers it to third man and picks up an easy single.
That one zipped through! Good-length ball, outside off, takes Hafeez by surprise as he watches it sail through to the keeper.
On a driving length, outside off. Hafeez strokes it through covers for a couple.
Full and straight, thumped down the ground for a single.
Length again and Hafeez pushes it towards the cover region. Pakistan are 36/2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Right on the money from Anrich Nortje. Length ball, on off and jagging back in. Mohammad Hafeez stays solid in defense.
Mohammad Hafeez walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent bowling from Anrich Nortje and Mohammad Rizwan was looking a bit too edgy. Trying to up the ante, Rizwan dances down the track to a bowler who bowls around 150 clicks. Rizwan gets beaten for pace and ends up chipping the ball towards extra cover. Keshav Maharaj is there and pouches it safely. Both the openers are now back in the hut for Pakistan.
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Around middle and leg, Rizwan looks to heave it on the leg side but the ball stays a bit low. Rizwan gets an inside edge and the ball races away into the fine leg fence.

Ooh, that looked like a nasty blow on the ribs. Good-length ball, angled in at middle. Mohammad Rizwan looks to swipe across but is through the shot early and the ball crashes into his mid-section. Hope he is fine.
Down the leg side but its slower in pace. Rizwan is through his flick early and the ball clips the pads on its way to the keeper.
Anrich Nortje is into the attack.
A length ball, on middle. Rizwan nudges it towards mid on and sets off for a quick run.

That one completely deceives the batter. A slower bouncer, around off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to pull it away but gets undone by the lack of pace and gets hit on the shoulder. That must have stung a bit.
Pitched up, around middle. Fakhar Zaman looks to swing across but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Good-length ball, on off and slanting across. Zaman mistimes his back foot drive towards cover.
Back of a length, around off. Rizwan dabs it down to third man and picks up a run.
A leg stump half-volley, nicely tucked away through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Lungi Ngidi is into the attack.
Good-length ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman looks to play an expansive drive but misses. 7 runs and a wicket from the over.
Fakhar Zaman is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! A magnificent yorker from Rabada! Pitches it on off, Babar Azam tries to squeeze it out but is too late in bringing his bat down. The ball sneaks under his bat and shatters the stumps. What a delivery that was from Kagiso Rabada. He draws first blood.
Brilliant running! On a length, on off. Babar Azam hops and taps it towards point. The fielder there misfields and allows the batters to come back for the second run.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, Azam looks to flick but misses. Wided.
FOUR! A gift from Kagiso Rabada, bowls it on the pads. Babar Azam clips it towards deep square leg and fetches himself a boundary.
On a length, on off. Babar Azam punches it towards cover-point.
Good-length ball, on middle. Babar Azam defends it out from the crease.
On middle, blocked out by Rizwan.
SIX! Bang! Tossed up delivery, on middle and Mohammad Rizwan skips down the track to smoke it over the wide long on fence for a huge hit.
On off and pushed towards mid off.
A low full toss, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Short and on leg, Rizwan makes room for himself and knocks it back o the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. Azam lifts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
On a length, on middle. Rizwan tucks it to mid-wicket. 7 runs from the over.
Full, on middle. Babar Azam nudges it to mid on for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Perfectly timed! Full again, on off. Babar Azam lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Very full, on middle. Babar Azam digs it out on the leg side.
On a length, on middle. Babar Azam tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball, on off. Azam pushes it to mid off.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Kagiso Rabada.
Floats it up, on leg. Mohammad Rizwan looks to sweep but misses. He gets hit on the thigh pad.
Top edge but safe! Tosses it up, on middle. Babar Azam looks to sweep. The ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan sweeps it to mid-wicket.
On midde, Babar Azam tucks it to square leg for one.
Pakistan and Mohammad Rizwan are underway! Loopy ball, on off. Rizwan look to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge towards backward point for a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Mohammad Rizwan pushes it to point.

We are set to begin! The South African players stride out to the middle. The Proteas players take a knee in support of Black Lives Matter. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam will open the innings for Pakistan. Keshav Maharaj to start with the ball.

South Africa  - Temba Bavuma (C), Quinton de Kock (WK), Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius, Keshav Maharaj, Bjorn Fortuin, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi, Wiaan Mulder, Anrich Nortje, Kagiso Rabada, Reeza Hendricks.

Pakistan - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan, Imad Wasim, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf, Sarfaraz Ahmed, Mohammad Nawaz, Haider Ali, Mohammad Wasim.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and have elected to FIELD first.

The Proteas batters struggled a bit against the Afghans. Batting first, they managed to put 145, that too, courtesy to Aiden Markram's knock of 48. He had a good run in the Indian T20 League and is entering the World Cup in rich form. Heading into this fixture, the other batters would also look to contribute some runs as well. Their bowlers did the job against Afghanistan by restricting them to 104. South Africa have never won a T20 World Cup and this time around, they would look to change their fortunes. Today is the one final chance for both sides to iron out their flaws before the main tournament starts. Stay tuned for further updates.

Pakistan were very dominant against West Indies in their first warm-up game. West Indies batters struggled to get going and only managed to put 130 on the board. It was a cakewalk for Pakistan as they chased down the target inside 16 overs and won the match by 7 wickets. They have a strong team and have all their bases covered. The Asian side are always unpredictable in the ICC tournaments and will be interesting to see how far they go in this World Cup.

Hello and a warm welcome to this warm-up match of the T20 World Cup where South Africa will take on Pakistan. South Africa played their first warm-up fixture against Afghanistan and had a convincing victory over them. On the other hand, Pakistan chased down a target of 131 comfortably against the defending champions in their first warm-up match. Both teams will look to fine tune their preparations before the real action begins and gain some valuable match practice and winning momentum from this game.
... WARM UP TIME ...
